interface Handler {
  onClick();
  onKey(key: string): void;
}
type Shape = { draw(); area(): number };
interface Factory {
  new ();
}
type Callable = {
  ();
};
abstract class Widget {
  abstract render();
  resize(width: number);
  resize(width: number) {
    return width;
  }
}
function format(value: number);
function format(value: number) {
  return String(value);
}
interface Temperature {
  get celsius();
  set celsius(value: number);
  get kelvin();
  set kelvin(value);
  get fahrenheit();
}
console.log(format(1));
